name: codex-voice-reply-plugin
description: Speak concise Mandarin voice summaries before Codex sends written replies.

interface.shortDescription: Speak Mandarin result summaries before Codex replies.
interface.longDescription: Codex Voice Reply adds a voice-reply skill and local PowerShell helpers for speaking concise Mandarin result summaries before the final written response. The default neural voice is zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural at rate +7% and pitch -1Hz.
interface.defaultPrompt: Before your final written response, use the voice-reply skill to speak a concise Mandarin result summary.
